rationale: All sixteen shared-channel configurations failed. The strongest mean 0.3695165217122956 missed the fixed margin and had two negative-transfer days. Earlier diagnostics found a nearly rank-one labeled prefix on the largest harmful day. Test a development-inspired coverage heuristic, without identifying dates: whiten prefix velocity by the source covariance and retain the source readout if its minimum-to-maximum covariance eigenvalue ratio is below 0.01 (condition number above 100). Otherwise use shared-channel reweighting unchanged. This rule is selected on reused development data, not causal evidence. The first passing candidate stops all further search; sealed data remain unavailable until freeze.
